name: text/staggered-fade-up
title: Staggered Fade Up
title_vi: Từng từ nổi lên, phóng nhẹ, rõ dần
desc_vi: Từng từ lần lượt nổi lên 22 px, từ mờ 5 px và nhỏ 0.92 lần về đúng cỡ; đổi được hướng vào.
params_vi: duration (0.3 s) · stagger (0.055 s) · offset: quãng nổi (22 px) · reach: nhân quãng (close 0.5, far 1.85) · direction: up | down | left | right · scale (0.92) · blur (5 px)
notes: Only the motion is ported (the source's tone colour, 56 px size and 12 px word gap belong to the film). The source drives CSS variables (--hf-word-y, --hf-word-scale, --hf-word-blur) that a transform / filter read; here x, y, scale and filter are tweened directly with the same values. Variables direction and distance map to the params direction and reach (offset = 22 x reach, x or y by direction). The stagger is explicit start times (at + index x 0.055) across all words of all targets, as the source's selector does. The source's `words` variable (replace the words) is not a motion: put the text in the target. The registry components blur-out-up and per-word-crossfade use the same recipe (22 px, 0.92, 5 px blur, 0.3 s, stagger 0.055, power3.out), so this preset covers them too.
